_note: Where to read live job titles for contractors (federal entries use USAJOBS). Titles are read once per build, filtered to data/locations.json, and used only to make search find them. Every request first checks the site's robots.txt. Entries in 'skipped' are not read, with the reason.

skipped.saic: jobs.saic.com refuses automated requests (HTTP 403, even for robots.txt).
skipped.rtx-pratt-whitney: careers.rtx.com refuses automated requests (HTTP 403, even for robots.txt).
skipped.amentum: amentumcareers.com has no working location filter, and its search API is disallowed by robots.txt; reading all ~2,800 jobs daily is too heavy.
skipped.sts-systems-defense: The Dayforce job board loads only through scripts, and it may belong to a sibling company (see ROLES-REVIEW.md).
skipped.aafes-hill-exchange: No public job feed found on applymyexchange.com.
skipped.swri: Custom careers app (resapp.swri.org) with no location filter; not a supported platform yet.
skipped.jhu-apl: iCIMS Jibe careers site; not a supported platform yet.
skipped.hx5: Careers site is a Taleo board (no adapter for it); its ClearanceJobs Utah page is the card's second link.
skipped.rmc: Its Workable account slug couldn't be found; the card links the jobs.workable.com company page.
skipped.city-light-power: JobScore board; not a supported platform yet.
skipped.american-water-hill: SAP SuccessFactors site that only renders in a browser.
skipped.command-cyber-solutions: Taleo Business Edition; its location filter needs a form POST.
skipped.asrc-federal-netcentric: Dayforce portal; its search API refuses automated requests (403).
skipped.tecolote-research: Custom careers app that only renders in a browser.
skipped.summit-technologies: TriNet Hire board; not a supported platform yet.
skipped.nurses-etc-staffing: Sourceflow job board whose search isn't in the page HTML.
skipped.accenture-federal: Salesforce careers portal (its old Greenhouse board redirects there); no adapter.
skipped.astrion: Careers portal search loads by script; no adapter.
skipped.bechtel: Careers search drops the location filter; no adapter.
skipped.jt4: Careers page lists jobs by category through an external system; no adapter.
